They set up the assembly kits that enables our technicians to put together our Electron rockets, manage inventory, look after shipping and receiving, manage direct and indirect procurement, and inspect and ensure that all of our materials and products are compliant and up to standard. jobs.title: Scientist I, Drug Product Analytics (Laboratory Automation)
jobs.description_text: Summary: Vaxcyte is looking for an energetic, technically versatile scientist to join our Drug Product Development team and take ownership of laboratory automation within Drug Product Analytics. The primary focus of this role is to design, develop, program, and deploy automated analytical methods on Hamilton liquid handling platforms, beginning with the automation of our multiplexed immunoassay (MSD) suite. The ideal candidate can independently program, script, and troubleshoot robotic systems and can translate manual bench assays into robust, reproducible automated workflows. Practical experience analyzing and characterizing biomolecules (proteins, polysaccharide conjugates, vaccines), particularly by immunoassay and multiplexed immunoassay formats, is preferred; experience with vaccines and adjuvant-containing formulations is a plus. In addition, Vaxcyte is looking for an experienced and flexible individual who would be comfortable working on multiple projects at once, with fluid prioritization to enable aggressive timelines. This position is for a lab-based scientific role and requires excellent scientific judgement, independence, rigor, and thorough record-keeping. Essential Functions: Support the design, development, programming, and deployment of automated analytical methods on Hamilton liquid handling platforms, serving as the hands-on technical lead responsible for building, testing, validating, and maintaining automated assay workflows within Drug Product Analytics.

jobs.description_text: Schedule: Full Time Job Type: Hybrid Salary Type: Salary Req #: 3654 About the Role Uber Freight connects shippers with carriers, revolutionizing how goods move across the globe. Logistics is an intricate physical and digital ecosystem where minutes and timing equate to millions of dollars. We are looking for entrepreneurial Product Managers who thrive in ambiguity, love tackling multi-sided marketplace challenges, and possess the drive to build platforms that deliver measurable customer and business value at scale. As a Product Manager at Uber Freight, you will own a critical domain across our ecosystem—spanning AI & algorithmic optimization, marketplace liquidity and integrity, financial systems, or shipper/carrier experiences. You will partner with engineers, data scientists, designers, operations teams, and commercial stakeholders to translate complex logistics problems into scalable products and step-change business outcomes. What You'll Do Define Product Vision & Strategy: Own the end-to-end vision, strategy, and roadmap for a core product area. Translate complex logistics realities and market shifts into actionable hypotheses, clear milestones, and prioritized execution. Customer Obsessed: Empathize deeply with our dual-sided ecosystem—carriers, drivers, enterprise shippers, and internal operators.
